item.title: Querying CUR 2.0 with Amazon Athena
item.description:
Amazon Athena CUR 2.0 FinOps

Estimated duration: 15 mins

Querying CUR 2.0 with Amazon Athena

Overview

Athena turns cost questions into repeatable SQL. This is the analytical bridge between exported billing files and the CUDOS dashboard.

Learning Objectives

  • Run a minimal sanity query.
  • Aggregate cost over a verified period.
  • Break cost down by service or another dimension.
  • State the cost metric used.
  • Review query scan behavior.

Why This Matters for FinOps

A dashboard should be traceable back to a query or semantic definition. Reproducible SQL reduces ambiguity in financial analysis.

item.title: AWS Glue Data Catalog Inspection
item.description:
AWS Glue Amazon Athena Amazon S3

Estimated duration: 10 mins

AWS Glue Data Catalog Inspection

Overview

S3 stores objects; Glue tells query engines how to interpret them. A schema error can propagate into every downstream dashboard.

Learning Objectives

  • Find the Data Exports database.
  • Inspect the CUR table.
  • Review representative billing/product fields.
  • Compare the table location with the S3 path.

Why This Matters for FinOps

FinOps metrics are only trustworthy when the underlying schema and data location are understood.
